verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Slack incoming webhook URLs for posting messages to a channel. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit here. chat.postMessage is a token-based Web API method, not a simple webhook URL. Workflow Builder webhook triggers start a workflow from outside Slack, but nothing shows they post a message to a channel.

support.subject: As a developer, I can post a message into a channel with a simple incoming webhook URL
